material_art.provenance: Original VoxelCraft procedural pixel art, v0.18 track 3 (2026-11-23 and 24, three rounds): deepslate, andesite, diorite, granite, tuff, cobblestone, gravel, dirt, grass top and sides, sand, red sand, the sixteen stone and deepslate ores, nine leaves, the logs, log ends and planks of oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia, dark oak, mangrove, cherry and pale oak, the stripped logs and ends of the same nine, sandstone and red sandstone (sides, tops, bottom, cut), coarse dirt, podzol, mycelium, rooted dirt, clay, bedrock, polished andesite, diorite, granite, tuff and deepslate, cobbled deepslate, and (third round) stone bricks and their mossy, cracked and chiseled forms, bricks, nether, red nether, end stone and prismarine bricks, mud, packed mud and mud bricks, deepslate bricks and tiles, the tuff bricks and chiseled tuffs, blackstone and its polished, brick, chiseled and gilded forms, calcite, smooth stone, the chiseled sandstones, stripped bamboo, azalea and flowering azalea leaves, and plain and the sixteen coloured terracottas. Integer palette-and-cluster rules from docs/art-and-ui.md; no Minecraft texture was copied or traced
